findings.text: Copy with userfault write protection uses two single bit selectors occupying distinct low bit positions, one requesting protection handling and one requesting resolution, plus a combined selector covering both members.
Fast single address pin helper exposes a boolean outcome that reports success only when exactly one page is pinned for the supplied address and flags.
Resident set accounting exposes read and update helpers for per category counters, including approximate and exact summation variants and add increment and decrement adjustments with tracing.

Folio category resolves anonymous first, then distinguishes swap backed shared memory from file backed pages; total residency is the sum of the three categories with exact and approximate total variants, and high water marks track maxima of residency and virtual size with update reset and propagate helpers.
Generic page table entry markers for special mappings default to absent for all three leaf levels, and the corresponding constructors leave their input unchanged.

Upper level table creation helpers succeed without action when the level is folded away, while level descent helpers return the existing child slot or allocate on missing entries and report null only when allocation fails.

Page table memory accounting tracks bytes per allocated table while skipping folded levels, with initialization to zero, exact current byte query, and per level increment and decrement; an alternate configuration disables tracking entirely and always reports zero.
Middle level indexes derive from shifting the virtual address by the level shift and masking to the per table entry count, and child pointers are formed by adding that index to the parent table base.
Page table descriptor flags reuse two existing page flag positions to distinguish kernel owned tables from reserved tables, leaving higher positions for zone node and section information.
Unmapped area search parameters form a record carrying direction flags, requested length, low and high search bounds, alignment mask and offset, and required leading gap.
Top down unmapped area search direction is selected by a flag value of one.

Leaf and middle level table access is serialized by dedicated spin locks obtained from per table or address space storage, with paired map with lock and unlock with unmap operations and allocating variants that fail cleanly when table creation fails.
Huge page table entry used for deferred splitting is stored either inside the per middle level descriptor or inside the address space structure depending on configuration.
Reserved page management exposes release, mark reserved with managed count adjustment, and descriptor release helpers.
Boot and system wide helpers expose release of init image memory, total present page count summed over online nodes, a default early node mapping of zero, and a memory display using full zone range.

Reverse mapping traversal exposes iteration over virtual areas sharing a file offset interval and over anonymous chain entries sharing an anonymous offset interval, advancing from first to next until exhaustion.
Data segment growth check always succeeds under an infinite limit and otherwise rejects when the sum of new growth and existing initialized data extent exceeds the limit with a no space indication.

Unmapped area selection forwards caller file address length offset and flags with empty extra area flags, while population requests best effort faulting of a range in one configuration and does nothing in the other.

Start guard applies for downward growing areas and a single page for shadow stack areas, otherwise zero; effective area bounds extend by the applicable guard with saturation on wrap, and page count is the byte span shifted by page size.

File and anonymous offsets derive end as start plus page count and last as end minus one, with anonymous start assembled from low and optional high components on wide builds and descriptor byte size and page count derived from start end span.

Remap style mapping actions record a target interval inside the descriptor together with start frame and protection, with full range convenience covering the whole descriptor and input range usage constrained inside the descriptor; input output variant shares the same record with a distinct action type.

Simple input output remap records a physical base and size with its own action type, while kernel page mapping records start, page array, count and descriptor offset, with a full descriptor convenience using the descriptor page count.

Exact area lookup succeeds only when a covering area matches both bounds, subset testing requires outer bounds to enclose inner bounds, and containment helpers reject null inputs before applying subset testing to area or descriptor bounds.

Protection derivation converts modern area flags to legacy flags then to hardware protection in one configuration and yields empty protection otherwise, with area based accessors and a setter that caches the derived value in the area.

Fault result construction maps memory shortage to out of memory, poison to poison, bus or segmentation indications to fault error, and maps filesystem completion to locked, transient fault indicators to no page, and other persistent failures to bus error; single page insertion maps shortage and unexpected failures accordingly while busy is treated as no page.
Input output remap helpers expose identity frame translation for a range and a range remap that applies decryption handling to protection before delegating to frame remap.

Get user pages handling of protection none entries refuses to bypass faults for write protection tracking areas while accessible, honors numa hint bypass only when requested, and otherwise permits bypass only in inaccessible areas so forced access can progress.
Page table walk exposes a callback type receiving a leaf entry pointer, virtual address and opaque data with integer status result.

High water residency update tolerates concurrent reads, guard extension saturates on address wrap, remap range misuse is warned rather than enforced, and forcing faults in inaccessible areas would stall progress so bypass rules differ there.

Page table descent proceeds through successive levels from top to leaf, reusing present intermediate entries and creating missing ones on demand, ending either with a usable child pointer or a null failure when creation fails.
Page table utilities expose a reserved state query on descriptors and a profiling aware allocation entry point.
